decrypted_structure.note: Gold answers ('answer', 'arxiv_id') ship inside the same records as the questions. Plaintext question/answer text is deliberately NOT reproduced in this repository; only counts, field names and hashes are recorded.

plaintext_retention: Decrypted plaintext retained only under the session scratchpad; not committed to this repository. Upstream README asks that decrypted questions/answers not be reposted online.
secret_required_note: The published bundle uses scheme 'public_canary_xor_sha256'. decrypt_benchmark.py derives the XOR mask as sha256(canary_string) where canary_string is stored in the bundle metadata itself; no password, key or credential was supplied or needed. The repository also implements an AES-GCM/scrypt path (via cryptography) for a passphrase-protected variant, which the published bundle does not use.
